Seedance 2.5 finally dropped, and it’s actually way better than expected.

It can generate 30s clips but “long video mode” goes up to 3mins. A ~10x jump in sota video gen length is unprecedented (we were ~2x-ing every 6mos)

This entire trailer, with audio, was oneshotted by it. https://t.co/DvuHQpaJzh

tang tan would have a field day with this
https://t.co/yy1ikJ7E5m

and if you want to get *really* deep with the pros of air-gapped data transfer..

there's this thing called TrojPix [malware] that creates imperceptible pixel modulations that change the electromagnetic emissions on your video cables up to a range of 200m to exfiltrate files
